item.title: Synthetic Worlds for Temporal Evaluation and Knowledge Updating in LLMs
item.content:encoded: Large language models (LLMs) rely on static pretraining corpora, causing their knowledge to become outdated over time. Existing approaches for evaluating knowledge edits either suffer from rapid contamination or rely on counterfactual edits that conflict with rigid existing knowledge. In this work, we propose a synthetic, simulation-driven framework for studying knowledge insertion in LLMs. We introduce {\sc ParallelEvents}, a benchmark of fictional yet realistic future worlds that generates coherent event trajectories for controlled evaluation, avoiding contamination while preserving consistency. Building on this dataset, we develop {\sc Synapse}, a training framework that uses model-generated data to update model parameters via mid-training and instruction tuning. This synthetic pipeline enables scalable knowledge integration without costly human-curated data. Empirically, {\sc Synapse} outperforms existing methods by 14.23\%, demonstrating that simulation-based synthetic training leads to robust and coherent knowledge insertions.

item.title: 通用视觉语言模型适配多光谱与SAR任务
item.content:encoded:
通过渲染输入和LoRA微调，通用VLM可适配多光谱与SAR任务。



摘要： 本文提出一种轻量级方法，将通用视觉语言模型（VLM）适配至多光谱和合成孔径雷达（SAR）任务。通过将每个观测结果渲染为五张光学视图和一张SAR视图，并在提示中命名，结合LoRA技术对语言网络和部分视觉Transformer块进行微调，使模型能够利用光谱指数和雷达后向散射信息。实验表明，该方法在六类土地覆盖识别任务中达到0.8275的micro F1分数，并且适用于多种VLM架构，同时在洪水验证和图像描述任务中也表现出色。控制实验进一步验证了模型确实依赖于提供的传感器数据。

item.content:encoded:
研究文档图像中PII脱敏效果，揭示OCR与布局对隐私保护的影响。



摘要： 本文探讨了在文档图像（如扫描件、截图和PDF）中进行个人身份信息（PII）脱敏的挑战。由于OCR错误、布局结构和视觉噪声，敏感信息可能未被完全移除。作者引入了LeakageBench数据集，包含500张文档图像和11,954个符合GDPR标准的PII标注，涵盖直接标识符、链接键和上下文重识别表面。研究评估了OCR管道、商业检测器和OCR-free模型的性能，发现即使使用先进工具，仍有多数页面存在隐私泄露风险。结果表明，需要更强的检测能力和工具支持来提高脱敏效果。

item.title: 大语言模型作为主观任务评判者的社会人口特征影响研究
item.content:encoded:
大语言模型在主观任务中受社会人口特征影响，偏向多数群体判断。



摘要： 本文研究了大语言模型作为主观任务评判者时，其判断是否受到社会人口特征的影响。通过对比23个开放权重的大语言模型在三种不同社会人口条件下的预测分布，发现无社会人口信息的模型更倾向于复制白人、受过高等教育的标注者判断。此外，社会人口特征引导使模型更偏向多数群体，对少数群体产生负面影响，尤其是在涉及冒犯性的任务中，交叉性特征会加剧这种偏差。研究还指出指令调优可能是导致这种不对称性的原因，因此在使用社会人口特征引导来估计群体判断时需谨慎，以免偏离少数群体的真实分布。

item.title: 高效评估对模型行为基准测试结论稳定性的影响研究
item.content:encoded:
高效评估影响模型基准测试结果的稳定性，需验证其有效性。



摘要： 本文通过在BBQ和BBQ-V基准上对三种密集模型和专家混合模型进行七种条件下的测试，探讨了高效评估对模型行为结论稳定性的影响。研究不仅关注准确率，还比较了偏差严重性、推理质量、子组行为、子集成员稳定性、运行时间和GPU能耗等指标。结果显示，较大批次处理能保持接近基线的准确率并减少能耗，而INT8和INT4量化方式对模型性能有不同影响。减少基准测试虽节省资源，但小子集对内容敏感。因此，高效评估应被视为一种测量干预，需针对其支持的结论进行验证。

item.title: 基于投影的瑞曼梯度下降算法实现维度无关的Bures-Wasserstein均值计算
item.content:encoded:
提出一种投影RGD算法，实现维度无关的快速收敛。



摘要： 本文研究了正定矩阵集的Bures-Wasserstein均值计算问题，针对现有方法在维度依赖和步长选择之间的权衡，提出了一个投影的瑞曼梯度下降（Projected RGD）算法。该算法在单位步长下实现了维度无关的线性收敛，收敛速率为 $1 - κ^{-3/2}$，优于传统小步长方法。核心创新在于提出了一种新的投影引理，证明对正定矩阵的特征值进行截断等价于在BW度量下的非扩张投影。该投影无需额外计算成本，可复用后续迭代所需的特征分解。该分析也适用于Brahmachari等人提出的不变矩阵投影问题，进一步扩展了该方法的适用范围。

item.content:encoded:
研究联邦环境下非高斯线性模型的因果发现方法。



摘要： 本文探讨了在联邦学习环境中应用线性非高斯无环模型（LiNGAM）进行因果发现的问题。由于数据隐私限制，无法集中所有数据，因此需要在保护隐私的同时提高因果推断的准确性。传统的LiNGAM方法无法直接应用于联邦环境，而高阶累积张量提供了一种解决方案，可在单一通信轮次内完成水平、垂直和混合分区的联合分析。然而，现有方法FedISHC在近对称噪声下表现不佳。为此，作者提出了FedRCD算法家族，并验证了其在不同通信轮次与噪声敏感度之间的权衡。实验表明，基于累积的方法在实际样本规模下无法按总体不对称性排序变量，而是根据图结构中的方差梯度进行排序。

item.title: 心理问答中检索增强生成的效果与控制策略研究
item.content:encoded:
研究显示检索增强生成在心理问答中效果不一，选择性检索可提升安全性。



摘要： 本文探讨了检索增强生成（RAG）在单次心理问答中的效果，发现其对用户情绪、治疗和安全需求的响应并不总是有益。研究通过三个条件驱动的效用维度评估检索需求，并构建了一个包含应对策略、心理教育和安全资源的指南语料库。实验对比了闭卷、始终检索和选择性检索三种设置，结果显示始终检索虽提高回答具体性，但降低整体质量并引发安全问题。而选择性检索在低需求情况下保持闭卷行为，避免了无条件检索带来的负面效果，表明检索激活应作为安全敏感的控制决策。

item.content:encoded:
研究发现大语言模型可能无法真正控制内部表示。

item.content:encoded:
OPD-then-RL在逻辑与数学推理任务中表现优于单一方法。



摘要： 本文提出了一种基于OPD（on-policy distillation）和RLVR（reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards）的两阶段方法，即先进行OPD再进行RLVR。实验表明，该方法在多个逻辑和数学推理基准测试中优于纯OPD、纯RLVR以及联合基线模型。研究进一步通过pass@$k$行为、学习动态和参数更新分析了其有效性，发现OPD扩展了学生对教师支持解决方案的覆盖范围，而RL则在此基础上进行优化。联合优化会导致信号干扰，因此采用分阶段策略更有效。研究还指出OPD验证分数是切换到RL的关键信号，并证明OPD比SFT更适合作为RL的冷启动。

item.title: DVBench：评估多模态大模型在数据视频理解中的基准测试
item.content:encoded:
DVBench用于评估MLLMs在数据视频理解中的表现，揭示模型性能与参数规模及叙事能力的关系。



摘要： 尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在图表理解和视频分析方面取得进展，但现有评估多为孤立进行，缺乏对动态结构化视觉信息的综合评估。为此，研究者提出了DVBench，一个针对数据视频的基准测试，该视频结合动态图表与结构化叙事。DVBench包含300个真实数据视频和1000个人工验证的问答对，通过半自动化流程构建。实验评估了九个MLLMs，发现Gemini-3.1-Pro表现最佳，而Kimi-k2.5是性能最强的开源模型。研究还发现开源模型性能并不严格随参数规模增长，且叙事能力不等于视觉理解能力。进一步分析揭示了各维度的弱点以及帧配置和字幕输入的影响，为未来MLLM发展提供参考。DVBench已公开可用。

item.title: Information Density Imbalance in Visual Object Detection
item.content:encoded: In object detection, the number of instances is typically used to determine whether a dataset exhibits a long-tailed distribution, implicitly assuming that the model will perform poorly on categories with fewer instances. This assumption has led to extensive research on category bias in datasets with imbalanced instance numbers. However, even in datasets where instance numbers are relatively balanced, models still exhibit category bias, indicating that instance count alone cannot explain this phenomenon. In this work, we first introduce the concept and measurement of information density. We then observe a significant negative correlation between a category's information density and its accuracy, and we investigate how the training process impacts this relationship. Empirical studies suggest that information density imbalance may be a potential source of category bias. To preliminarily validate the potential of information density, we made simple improvements to three advanced object detection loss functions using this concept. Experiments on the Pascal VOC, COCO-LT, and LVIS datasets demonstrate that information density can significantly reduce model bias while effectively enhancing the overall performance of existing loss functions. This study provides a new perspective for understanding the generalized bias phenomenon in object detection models and offers new tools for designing fairer loss functions and training strategies.

item.title: Occupancy-based Quantile Risk Control
item.content:encoded: Conformal risk control is an emerging framework for the safe deployment of machine learning models with finite-sample guarantees. To accommodate a broader class of risk notions, quantile risk control extends this framework to quantile-based risk measures. However, existing methods either suffer from excessive conservatism or lack rigorous finite-sample guarantees. To address these limitations, we introduce Occupancy-based Quantile Risk Control (OQRC), a novel method that provides tight risk control bounds with finite-sample validity. Our key idea is to formulate risk control as a finite-occupancy problem by partitioning the loss space with the ordered calibration losses. Specifically, we estimate the distribution of test losses across the resulting bins and upper-bound the risk by the maximum loss attained within each bin. We then select the parameter $λ$ such that this upper bound does not exceed a predefined threshold $α$ with high probability $1-δ$. Theoretically, we establish a finite-sample guarantee showing that OQRC yields tight risk control bounds that converge to the optimal bounds at a provable rate of $\mathcal{O}_ p(n^{-1/2})$. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, reducing the risk gap by up to 78.64\% on common benchmarks.

item.title: Environment Evolution for Terminal Agents
item.content:encoded: Scaling interactive and verifiable environments is critical for training terminal agents. As frontier models become more capable, environments synthesized from scratch become less challenging and thus provide limited learning signals. Recent co-evolution methods iteratively synthesize environments near the model's learnable frontier based on weaknesses exposed during rollouts. However, their dependence on on-policy rollouts limits generalization and the continuous provision of learning signals as the model becomes stronger. In this paper, we propose environment evolution, which incrementally increases environment difficulty off-policy and schedules the evolved environments generation by generation during training to provide continuous learning signals. We derive three evolution directions that influence environment difficulty from the multi-turn learning objective and then implement evolution along these directions through a loop-engineered multi-agent harness. Quantitative rollout experiments with Hy4 preview, Claude Opus 5, and GPT-5.6 Sol show that environment evolution consistently produces more difficult environments. We validate its effectiveness on Qwen3.6-27B and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B through simple long-horizon RL training, improving their performance by 14.4 and 18.0 percentage points on Terminal-Bench 2.1, respectively.

item.title: Spurious Advantage Hidden in GRPO
item.content:encoded: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely studied for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, where its advantage estimator assigns each rollout a magnitude from within-group reward statistics. In the common case, this magnitude rewards rollouts that reach the correct answer through reasoning. Yet, an overlooked case shares the same surface: a rollout may land on it by guessing, and the formula still assigns a high magnitude, which we identify as the spurious advantage. This arises in three cases: bounded-answer tasks with a small candidate set; open-answer sets hosting bounded sub-cases; and search agents whose budget opens many paths to the same answer. In all three, this misleads the policy toward guess-like behaviors. We propose SIGNBALANCE, whose magnitude is composition-free: it keeps the verifier sign, uses a global scale, and restores zero-mean balance via a stop-gradient per-class rescaling. Across math and search agent benchmarks at different scales, SIGNBALANCE matches GRPO on open-answer math and improves on bounded-answer math and search agents. Code will be released.

item.title: DRACO: Fine-Grained Credit Assignment with Dynamic Rubrics for Long-Horizon Agent Training
item.content:encoded: Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards works well when a task has a programmatic checker, but most long-horizon agent domains have none. We work in the outcome-blind setting, where ground-truth success signals are not available. Multi-criteria rubrics are a popular way to supply such a reward; they are scored once per trajectory, but a single scalar is a poor signal across tens of steps. We propose DRACO: Distributing Rubric-based Advantage for Credit Optimization. It generates rubrics dynamically during training to track the policy's evolving capability, scores those rubrics once per completed trajectory, and redistributes that judgment over the steps responsible for annotated rubrics to produce differentiated per-step advantages in GRPO. The redistribution is closed-form and does not introduce any trained attribution module. On AppWorld, DRACO gains 15.9 points over the base model and 5.3 points over GRPO trained with a sparse ground-truth reward, despite not using any verifiers itself. On out-of-domain Tau-Bench, it gains 5.3 points over the base model even without a frontier judge, beating both ground-truth-reward training and other rubric-based training settings. The code for DRACO is available at https://github.com/IBM/draco.

item.title: GAPS: Dimension-Level Gates for Conditional Activation Steering
item.content:encoded: Activation steering suppresses undesired behaviors in language models by adding a steering vector to the hidden state during generation. Recent conditional methods such as CAST and DSAS improve the behavior-capability trade-off by deciding when to intervene, but once active, they apply the full dense vector to all hidden dimensions, regardless of whether a neuron carries concept information or already lies in the desired regime. We introduce dimension-level conditioning as a complementary axis of selectivity that also decides which neurons to intervene on. Our method, GAPS (Gated Activation steering via Posterior and Separability), combines two training-free gates: a static separability gate that restricts steering to neurons with statistically reliable concept information (via AUROC), and a dynamic posterior gate that steers a neuron only when its current activation is better explained by the undesired concept under a Gaussian model. The gates add O(D) overhead per token, and they plug into existing conditional methods. On toxicity mitigation (RealToxicityPrompts) and concept removal (OneSeC) with Gemma-3 (4B) and Qwen-3 (1.7B), GAPS consistently matches or improves the Pareto front of its token-level counterparts; under a fixed capability budget, DSAS+GAPS reduces Gemma-3's toxicity rate from 6.52% to 0.48%, versus 3.52% for DSAS alone. Ablations attribute most of the gain to the posterior gate.

item.title: Beyond Retrieval: Progressive Latent Memory Evolution for Streaming Video Understanding
item.content:encoded: Streaming video understanding requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to process continuous visual inputs and respond to user queries under strict causality and bounded memory. Existing approaches typically compress historical observations into an external memory bank and retrieve query-relevant evidence as additional visual context. Though effective, this store-and-retrieve paradigm keeps historical evidence as external visual context, preventing it from being internalized into a compact, evolving latent memory that can continuously guide streaming reasoning. To bridge this gap, we introduce LatentStream, a progressive latent working memory framework that shifts streaming memory from store-and-retrieve to retrieve-and-internalize. Specifically, LatentStream comprises three coordinated components. First, Query-agnostic Hierarchical Streaming Memory organizes visual history into short-, mid-, and long-term levels under a fixed memory budget through Jenks-guided adaptive consolidation. Once a query arrives, Hierarchical Latent Memory Evolution equips groups of latent memory tokens with progressively expanding memory receptive fields, enabling them to iteratively retrieve historical evidence from their corresponding scopes and internalize it into a compact, fixed-length latent memory. Finally, Progressive Confidence-guided Latent Memory Optimization constructs a hierarchical progression reward from group-wise predictive entropy and jointly refines the latent memory tokens and retrieved evidence, encouraging increasingly confident streaming reasoning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LatentStream achieves new state-of-the-art results on existing online and offline video benchmarks.

item.title: Generative Retrieval for E-commerce: Jointly Learning Embedding and Codebook with Same Product Cluster
item.content:encoded: With the development of large language models (LLMs), generative retrieval is becoming increasingly important in e-commerce scenarios. Current mainstream approaches typically use a two-stage training strategy: first train a product embedding model, and then learn a codebook that maps embeddings to product IDs. This cascaded approach suffers from two major issues: (1) error accumulation-if the embedding model in the first stage produces biased representations, the codebook in the second stage cannot correct these errors, degrading final retrieval performance; and (2) codebook learning relies solely on product embeddings and lacks modeling of query-to-product and product-to-product interactions. As a result, products belonging to the same cluster may be assigned inconsistent IDs by the codebook, further hurting retrieval accuracy. To address these problems, we propose a novel method that jointly trains the embedding model and the codebook, and incorporates same product cluster information as an additional supervision signal. Experimental results demonstrate that our method significantly improves e-commerce retrieval performance while simultaneously enhancing both embedding and codebook learning.

item.title: FoundYou: A Unified Model for Personalized Segmentation and Retrieval
item.content:encoded: Personalized segmentation and personalized retrieval both aim to identify the same physical object across different images. While the former localizes the object within a target image, the latter retrieves images where it appears. Despite this shared instance-level objective, the two tasks have largely evolved separately and are addressed with distinct solutions. In this work, we introduce FoundYou, a unified framework built on the observation that Segment Anything 2 (SAM 2), trained to preserve object identity across video frames, inherently captures instance-level cues. We leverage this property to match objects across independent images, enabling segmentation and retrieval to emerge as two outcomes of the same instance alignment process. This unified view unlocks new capabilities beyond traditional benchmarks, including few-shot personalized retrieval and promptable personalized segmentation with flexible prompts. Extensive experiments show consistent gains over unified and task-specific methods, including +18.4 mIoU on PerMIS and +17.8 mAP on ILIAS. Performance scales with additional references and remains robust to weaker prompts. Beyond personalization, FoundYou achieves state-of-the-art results on category-level retrieval benchmarks. Notably, our approach keeps the SAM 2-small model entirely frozen and adds only 5.9 M trainable parameters, yielding a 52 M-parameter model that is over 75x faster and 20x smaller than the only prior unified solution. Code is available at https://github.com/ga1i13o/FoundYou .

item.title: 多语言大模型安全评估框架IndicSafeEval的提出
item.content:encoded:
研究揭示多语言大模型在安全评估中的差异性表现。



摘要： 本文介绍了IndicSafeEval，一个针对印度语言的安全评估框架，用于测试大语言模型在不同语言和说服策略下的安全行为。该基准涵盖10类安全关键内容和6种人类般的说服策略，覆盖四种印度语言，生成7200个对抗性提示。实验发现，模型在不同语言和提示风格中的安全性表现不一致，且不同风险类别对说服性攻击的敏感度不同。研究强调当前安全评估主要基于英语，需建立多语言和说服感知的评估体系以更准确评估实际安全性能。

item.title: 基于梯度对齐奖励的强化学习方法提升大语言模型推理能力
item.content:encoded:
GAR方法通过梯度对齐提升大模型推理性能，效果优于现有基线。



摘要： 本文提出一种名为Gradient-Aligned Reward (GAR) 的强化学习方法，用于提升大语言模型的链式推理能力。GAR通过在策略的梯度空间中操作，利用输出投影层的截断反向传播提取紧凑的梯度向量，并与专家梯度进行余弦相似度计算，生成密集且具备推理感知的奖励信号。该方法仅带来不到9%的运行时间开销，并能分解为预测误差和激活模式因素。实验表明，GAR在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B模型上优于GRPO和其他基线，在数学竞赛基准测试中表现优异，并能在无需领域特定数据的情况下迁移至GPQA Diamond和MMLU-Pro任务。代码和数据已公开。

item.title: 语言模型评估系统的稳定性与可重复性研究
item.content:encoded:
评估系统稳定性不足，影响模型排名结果的可重复性。



摘要： 本文研究了语言模型评估系统在不同时间点对相同请求的响应一致性问题。通过两次预注册实验，发现相同请求在不同时间点的排名一致性较低（Spearman相关系数0.400和0.78），远低于预期标准。研究指出三个导致不一致的原因：标签到语义的映射偏差、候选样本差距过小以及字节完全相同的输入返回不同排名。实验还表明，更换提供方、采样或调整模型架构均无法解决该问题。研究提出了一套评估框架和报告清单，以提高评估系统的透明度和可靠性。结论强调，在共享服务基础设施上，模型名称不能被视为固定工具，评估应在冻结任何决策前进行验证。

item.title: BRIDGE: An Open-Source Humanoid Platform via Morphology-Control Co-Design for Physical AI
item.content:encoded: Developing humanoid robots capable of leveraging human behavioral data is essential for general-purpose embodiment, yet conventional development remains bottlenecked by a decoupled paradigm that isolates hardware design from whole-body control. This approach leads to suboptimal systems that compromise human-like fluidity and agility. To bridge this gap, we introduce a data-driven morphology-control co-design framework that optimizes humanoid morphology for human-like movement. To quantify morphological fidelity, we also introduce a novel metric that jointly considers kinematic retargeting fidelity to human motion and dynamic tracking performance. Our framework achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across all metrics compared to baseline humanoids (Bumi, K1, and Toddlerbot). Finally, we realize this design in Bridge, an open-source, 88cm-tall humanoid platform released alongside its control policy. We demonstrate that Bridge captures human motion data with superior fidelity, exhibiting exceptional performance across foundational locomotion, robust balance, and highly dynamic maneuvers. Videos and open-source materials: https://sites.google.com/view/bridgerobot.

item.title: BooM-VVT: Boosting Mask-Free Video Virtual Try-On with Image-Level Pseudo Data
item.content:encoded: Video virtual try-on (VVT) aims to generate realistic videos of a person wearing a target garment. Recent methods leverage a keyframe-driven video generation paradigm to improve in-the-wild performance, yet they still rely on masks to localize try-on regions, making them vulnerable to large motions and severe occlusions. Although mask-free image-based try-on methods have shown promising results by leveraging large-scale pseudo data, extending this paradigm to videos remains difficult, as constructing video-level pseudo data is prohibitively expensive. Furthermore, coarse keyframe sampling and the scarcity of multi-view try-on data limit existing keyframe-driven methods in maintaining garment consistency and handling diverse try-on tasks. To address these challenges, we propose BooM-VVT, a mask-free VVT framework built upon the keyframe-driven paradigm. To achieve mask-free VVT, we introduce a multi-stage training strategy that leverages image-level pseudo data for mask-free localization learning, substantially reducing the need for costly video-level pseudo data. To improve garment consistency, we propose Garment-Sensitive Keyframe Sampling, which selects keyframes based on garment-relevant body regions to better capture garment appearance. We further introduce Frame-Shared 3D-RoPE to establish spatiotemporal correspondences between keyframes and target video frames for accurate garment-detail transfer. Finally, we construct OmniView, a large-scale multi-view try-on dataset to support reliable try-on video generation under complex camera viewpoints and diverse try-on tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BooM-VVT achieves superior temporal consistency and garment fidelity over existing methods. Project page: https://boomvvt.github.io/boomvvt.

item.title: Puffin-World: Scaling a Unified Multimodal Model with Native 3D World States
item.content:encoded: We propose Puffin-World, a unified multimodal architecture that integrates physical understanding, spatial simulation, and 3D world generation and reconstruction without relying on external offline modules. To reliably construct and interact with 3D worlds, our framework jointly models three native world states: physics (gravity field and latitude), geometry (depth), and appearance (image), together with a unified Omni-Camera representation that supports diverse tasks and flexible motions. Beyond modeling these states, we introduce a strategy for propagating physical dynamics across future frames. By grounding absolute camera properties in the real world, Puffin-World enables physically consistent and visually stable world generation. We further couple appearance and geometry within a single generative process, jointly synthesizing each future view and reconstructing its underlying geometry. This unified paradigm enables interleaved closed-loop applications requiring synergy across multiple tasks, including mimic and self-calibrated world exploration. To scale Puffin-World to complex scenarios, we construct Puffin-16M, comprising 15 million vision-language-camera triplets and 1 million trajectories featuring various and challenging motions. To foster further research in this area, we released the code, models, and datasets.

item.content:encoded:
研究伯努利核及其逆整数水平集的几何特性，涉及黎曼零点与复数结构。



摘要： 本文探讨了有序伯努利核 f(p,n,k)=p^k(1-p)^(n-k) 及其逆整数水平集所生成的几何结构。当二进制水平为 2^(-n) 时，选择 p=1/2 作为唯一的实数独立锚点。在保持补集的复数延拓下，得到 z=1/2+iu 和 1-z=1/2-iu 的共轭对称垂直几何。二次坐标 Q(z)=z(1-z)=1/4+u^2 在中心点有尖锐极小值，并可精确整数量化。对于临界线零点 ordinates gamma_k，诱导水平 L_k=1/4+gamma_k^2 被分解为整数部分 N_k 和周期性第一伯努利残差 delta_k。通过圆化处理得到 Z_k=exp(2 pi i delta_k)，将 gamma_k^2 mod 1 作为残差相位变量。唯一分解定理将整数壳层分解为质数生成坐标，而复指数 s 将该构造提升至 Dirichlet 原子 m^(-s)，连接 Dirichlet 系列和 Euler 乘积结构。文中明确区分了精确恒等式、经典 zeta 连接、数值控制及开放条件 Weyl 测试，未声称证明黎曼假设。

item.title: 基于任务自适应压缩的病理学基础模型优化
item.content:encoded:
TAP-Path提升病理模型效率与准确性。



摘要： 本文提出TAP-Path框架，通过任务自适应压缩技术优化病理学基础模型。该方法对预训练的Virchow2编码器进行直接重构，而非采用知识蒸馏方式。TAP-Path结合了验证驱动的Transformer块选择、冗余块移除、输入自适应的补丁-标记剪枝、多深度特征恢复以及轻量级门控任务头等技术。实验结果显示，该模型在保留24个Transformer块和70%补丁标记的情况下，参数减少24.96%，计算量降低35.20%。在32类病理数据集上，TAP-Path达到了87.98%的测试准确率，优于全量Virchow2模型和UNI2-h模型。此外，在外部数据集上也取得了91.22%的准确率，证明其在保持可靠性的同时有效提升了模型的效率与性能。

item.title: MetaStructAtlas：用于全身体PET/CT分析的大规模多模态数据集
item.content:encoded:
提出MetaStructAtlas数据集，支持全身体PET/CT的多模态分析。



摘要： 本文介绍了MetaStructAtlas，这是一个用于全身体PET/CT解释的大规模多模态数据集，结合了解剖、代谢和语义标注。该数据集包含490个配准的3D PET和CT体积，以及50,470个器官级分割掩码和基于视觉的放射报告。此外，研究还开发了MetaStructVQA，一个包含100,565个问答对的标准化3D视觉问答基准，用于跨模态的诊断查询与视觉证据的关联分析。通过在MetaStructVQA上评估最先进的3D医学视觉语言模型，为核医学中的多模态表示学习和整体推理奠定了基础。

item.title: LEAP：基于潜在能量的高效动作规划方法
item.content:encoded:
LEAP提升模型预测控制成功率，通过优化潜在目标匹配与能量函数。



摘要： 本文提出一种名为LEAP（Latent Energy Action Planning）的动作规划方法，用于解决高维观测下潜在世界模型在模型预测控制中的局限性。LEAP将完整的动作序列视为可微变量，并通过冻结的LeWorldModel（LeWM）进行优化。该方法结合了终端潜在目标匹配与终端窗口状态能量，确保预测的终端潜在状态与目标一致。实验表明，在四个控制领域中，LEAP系统将平均成功率达到94.8%，相比传统的交叉熵方法提升了17.3个百分点，同时保持了LeWM的表示和预测能力。

item.title: 全双工语音代理的隐式指令遵循评估研究
item.content:encoded:
研究全双工语音代理在隐式指令下的表现与挑战。



摘要： 本文介绍了DSB-IFEval，一个用于评估全双工语音代理在实时语音交互中隐式指令遵循能力的基准测试。该测试涵盖8种助理角色和5种指令条件，通过IAS和PAS两个指标评估代理的地板管理能力和角色一致性内容。研究发现不同架构的模型在显式指令和角色推断指令下的表现差异显著，且即使遵循角色指令，面对安全冲突时仍难以调整行为。这表明，隐式行为推断、适时执行和解决冲突仍是全双工语音代理的重要挑战。

item.title: GrowPage：一种动态KV缓存预算框架提升LLM推理效率
item.content:encoded:
GrowPage通过动态调整KV缓存容量提升LLM推理性能。



摘要： 文章提出GrowPage，一种基于运行时需求的KV缓存预算框架，用于解决LLM推理过程中KV缓存成为内存瓶颈的问题。GrowPage利用轻量级双时间尺度查询摘要来捕捉近期和长期注意力行为，并根据相对注意力工作集估计需求变化。在每个容量边界，GrowPage可根据需求压缩当前分配的KV状态或获取额外物理页。该方法与PagedAttention的页面级内存抽象集成，保持连续批处理和前缀缓存，实验表明其在多个模型的推理基准上表现出优于现有方法的性能与吞吐量平衡。

item.title: 语言模型对输入扰动的多层级响应研究
item.content:encoded:
研究语言模型对不同输入扰动的多层级响应，揭示其鲁棒性评估的复杂性。



摘要： 本文探讨了六种自然和合成的输入扰动如何在解码器语言模型中传播，分析了输出行为、隐藏状态几何结构和注意力头功能三个层面。通过分析GPT-2和Qwen2.5模型的层间几何结构和注意力头响应，发现不同扰动类型产生可区分的指标特征，且这些特征不能完全由输出行为捕获。实验表明，复制分数与替换和打乱操作下的激活修复有关，而梯度引导的HotFlip扰动比随机替换造成更大的行为和表征破坏。研究结果表明，仅依赖单一行为或表征指标评估鲁棒性可能产生误导，需进行多层级评估。

item.title: 基于对象级标记的视觉语言模型响应研究
item.content:encoded:
通过对象级标记编辑提升视觉语言模型响应能力。



摘要： 本文提出一种在视觉语言模型（VLM）输入前进行表示层编辑的方法，通过将图像抽象为对象级标记，避免原始图像进入模型。研究引入了一种无需答案标注的协议，评估编辑后的逻辑回答，并通过反向验证确保结果可靠性。实验揭示了三种结构：显式编辑教学对密集场景有效，且在稀疏场景中效果增强；响应受标记清洁度和密度影响；图像无关的标记路径保留了92-96%的基线性能。该方法在两个遥感数据集和三个冻结语言模型中均表现稳定，相关代码与数据已公开。

item.title: 基于连续潜变量的语音增强方法MARSE
item.content:encoded:
MARSE通过连续NAC表示实现灵活的语音增强性能与计算成本平衡。



摘要： 本文提出了一种基于连续神经音频编解码器（NAC）表示的语音增强方法MARSE，该方法通过迭代解码被掩码的干净语音帧来提升语音质量与可懂度。研究中使用相同的DNN（Conformer模型）、NAC（DAC编解码器）和训练设置，探讨了多种解码策略。实验结果表明，MARSE在语音增强效果与计算开销之间提供了灵活的权衡，相关音频示例和代码已公开。

item.title: 群论中的光滑性与傅里叶系数的关联
item.content:encoded:
函数光滑性由傅里叶系数在低频集中体现，依赖于群和生成集的选择。



摘要： 文章探讨了实线上函数的光滑性与其傅里叶变换衰减之间的关系，并推广到L²(G)空间中函数的光滑性。对于非阿贝尔群G，通过其对称生成集S构造的Cayley图拉普拉斯矩阵在对偶空间上是块对角的，通过块内特征值的均值对不可约表示进行排序，从而定义了一个依赖于(G, S)的排序函数ω。该函数在0到2之间，仅在平凡表示处为零，在Cayley图是二分图时达到上限。研究还表明，满足自然公理的算子诱导的排序函数必须在平凡表示处为零，并在共轭对上一致。进一步限制条件如类权重非负性和均匀增量元素的定义，使得算子唯一确定为Cayley-Laplacian的正比例形式。该理论也适用于紧群和具有传递群作用的有限集。
